params.description: Ids of the Bgp Peer for the VPC

params.name: cidrsize
params.description: the CIDR size of VPC. For regular users, this is required for VPC with ROUTED mode.

params.name: asnumber
params.description: the AS Number of the VPC tiers

params.name: start
params.description: If set to false, the VPC won't start (VPC VR will not get allocated) until its first Network gets implemented. True by default.

params.name: sourcenatipaddress
params.description:
IPv4 address to be assigned to the public interface of the Network router.This address will be used as source NAT address for the Networks in ths VPC. 
If an address is given and it cannot be acquired, an error will be returned and the Network won´t be implemented,

params.name: keepmacaddressonpublicnic
params.description: Indicates whether to use the same MAC address for the public NIC of VRs on the same network. If "true", when creating redundant routers or recreating a VR, CloudStack will use the same MAC address for the public NIC of all VRs. Otherwise, if "false", new public NICs will always have  a new MAC address.
